audit.intended_rules: Ch.6 Tier 2 Berlin nightly cap (€160) vs €165 rate; Ch.9 trade-fair/event surcharge override check (note names "European Green Tech Summit" which is not the listed Berlin FinTech Summit and the stay is in November, so the tier cap governs); Ch.6 deduction of late check-out fees; Ch.6/Ch.11 minibar deduction (non-alcoholic minibar items still deducted); Ch.2 calculation order including VAT on deducted lines; Ch.6/Ch.14 full reimbursement of itemized Berlin city tax.
consistency_issues: Late checkout line bundles 'Overnight Luggage Storage' with the late checkout fee; luggage storage alone is not an enumerated deduction, but since the line is dominated by the late-checkout fee it is reasonable to deduct the whole line - minor ambiguity only.
realism_issues: City tax of €9.00 for 2 nights is low for Berlin: the Übernachtungsteuer is 5% of the net room rate (~€15.42 on a €308.42 net folio). Minor; does not affect adjudication.
Hotel name 'The Circus Hotel & Suites' closely resembles a real Berlin boutique hotel chain at a slightly different address; plausible overall.
audit.notes: Validator passes (1/1 valid). No label.json or receipt.jpg, so no label/receipt work needed. Nights of Tue 2023-11-14 and Wed 2023-11-15 are weekday nights, so Figure 1 is not triggered. Correct payout: 407.04 total − 10.70 (room excess over €160 cap incl. 7% VAT) − 26.215 (late checkout incl. VAT) − 18.725 (minibar incl. VAT) = €351.40, partially approved. The named event is a good distractor for the Ch.9 event-surcharge override. Clean subtle_multi case; only quibble is the slightly low city tax amount.
